environment: Python 3.14.7, Node 24.19, gh stub shim from testkit stub-server, no network

cases.title: Corpus values stay one path segment in a two-item argv
cases.given: a github repo and a gh shim
cases.when: read_rules runs on 8 corpus families (injection, traversal, flag-like, format strings, control chars, confusables, whitespace, oversized)
cases.then: each sample gives one gh call, argv exactly [api, repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/<one segment>], tree unchanged
cases.expected: each sample gives one gh call, argv exactly [api, repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/<one segment>], tree unchanged
cases.actual: each sample gives one gh call, argv exactly [api, repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/<one segment>], tree unchanged (observed)

evidence.title: attack log
evidence.inline: ATK-1: all entries held; only dot-only samples differ (see ATK-2)

cases.title: Dot-only samples stay unencoded
cases.then: path ends in branches/. and branches/.. (quote leaves dots alone)
cases.expected: path ends in branches/. and branches/.. (quote leaves dots alone)
cases.actual: path ends in branches/. and branches/.. (quote leaves dots alone) (observed)

cases.title: Placeholders and shell syntax are encoded; no marker file
cases.then: 12 calls, each argv length 2, tail has none of { } : $ ` ; & | newline quote space; marker file absent
cases.expected: 12 calls, each argv length 2, tail has none of { } : $ ` ; & | newline quote space; marker file absent
cases.actual: 12 calls, each argv length 2, tail has none of { } : $ ` ; & | newline quote space; marker file absent (observed)

cases.title: NUL in a sample is encoded as %00
Failure on the second sample leaks no partial rules
cases.given: gh answers rules for sample 1, exit 1 for sample 2
cases.then: 2 calls, rules [], by_sample {}, unchecked, one note
cases.expected: 2 calls, rules [], by_sample {}, unchecked, one note
cases.actual: 2 calls, rules [], by_sample {}, unchecked, one note (observed)

cases.title: Hostile gh stdout never raises
cases.given: stdout deep list (200000), deep object, NaN, 100000-digit int, trailing NUL, invalid UTF-8, non-dict items, bad parameters and type values, empty, blanks
cases.then: no exception; tree unchanged; one gh call
cases.expected: no exception; tree unchanged; one gh call
cases.actual: no exception; tree unchanged; one gh call (observed)

cases.title: Rule fields from gh output reach judge with odd types
cases.given: gh returns patterns that are int, dict, list, null and kind list
cases.then: read_rules does not raise; judge raises TypeError on 4 of 8 rules (out of scope: judge belongs to earlier slices, GitHub validates pattern types)
cases.expected: read_rules does not raise; judge raises TypeError on 4 of 8 rules (out of scope: judge belongs to earlier slices, GitHub validates pattern types)
cases.actual: read_rules does not raise; judge raises TypeError on 4 of 8 rules (out of scope: judge belongs to earlier slices, GitHub validates pattern types) (observed)

cases.title: Stderr with ANSI escapes, CR/LF, NUL and 1 MB text gives one note
cases.then: one call, one note, no rules
cases.expected: one call, one note, no rules
cases.actual: one call, one note, no rules (observed)

evidence.title: attack log
evidence.inline: ATK-8: note keeps ESC and newline raw; 1 MB note length 1000025. Seed.

cases.title: Token-like text in stderr appears in the note; env token never appears on success
cases.given: GH_TOKEN in env; gh stderr with ghp_ text
cases.then: success result holds no token; failure note carries stderr as the spec says
cases.expected: success result holds no token; failure note carries stderr as the spec says
cases.actual: success result holds no token; failure note carries stderr as the spec says (observed)

evidence.title: attack log
evidence.inline: ATK-9: note echoes stderr verbatim (spec text). Seed.

cases.title: Hung gh ends in one note after the timeout
cases.given: gh stalls, GH_TIMEOUT set to 1 second
cases.then: 1 call, one note naming the timeout, unchecked, 1 s
cases.expected: 1 call, one note naming the timeout, unchecked, 1 s
cases.actual: 1 call, one note naming the timeout, unchecked, 1 s (observed)

cases.title: A gh planted in the repo never runs
cases.given: repo holds ./gh and bin/gh that touch a marker; PATH has python3 and git only

cases.title: Hostile forge values never reach gh
cases.given: forge values GitHub, 'github ', 'github\n', GITHUB, 'github\0', gitlab, lists, objects, numbers, duplicate keys

cases.title: gh runs with cwd equal to the repo and the tree stays unchanged
cases.then: logged cwd equals the repo real path
cases.expected: logged cwd equals the repo real path
cases.actual: logged cwd equals the repo real path (observed)

cases.title: A 20000-rule body stays bounded
cases.then: all 20000 kept in 6.2 s (quadratic dedupe). Seed.
cases.expected: all 20000 kept in 6.2 s (quadratic dedupe). Seed.
cases.actual: all 20000 kept in 6.2 s (quadratic dedupe). Seed. (observed)

seeds.title: read_rules: dot-only samples are not encoded
seeds.detail: quote(safe='') keeps . and .. so the path ends in branches/.. . A dot segment can move the request. Git refuses these names, and the spec fixes the encoding, so no block.

seeds.title: read_rules: rule fields keep the JSON types from gh
seeds.detail: pattern and kind of any JSON type pass into rules. judge raises TypeError on int, dict, list and null patterns. S-015 should keep only str kind and pattern, or judge should treat other types as unevaluated.

seeds.title: read_rules: failure note keeps raw stderr
seeds.detail: The note keeps ANSI escapes, CR and LF, and up to any length. A token in stderr reaches the note and any log. Suggest collapsing control characters and capping the length.

seeds.title: read_rules: quadratic rule dedupe
seeds.detail: 20000 distinct rules take 6 s because of list membership tests. Use a seen set of serialized rules.
